title: Rerouting Russian Oil
summary:
Early impacts of the EU import ban and G7 price cap
On December 5, 2022, the EU ban on seaborne crude oil imports from Russia went into effect, accompanied by a $60 per barrel price cap for exports to countries outside the G7, the EU and Australia. While there are a few allowed exceptions, Europe has largely stopped importing oil from Russia. Did Russia reduce its exports and if so, who picked up the slack?
